items.question: My business is small: is going digital worth it?
items.answer: Yes, all the more so: in a small business every hour saved counts for more. We start with the one or two processes that waste the most time, such as quotes or paperwork, and only expand if it works.

items.question: Will I have to change my business software or buy new programs?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Often you can achieve a lot just by connecting the tools you already use. If something new is needed, I’ll suggest options with clear costs, free ones included.

items.question: Can AI really prepare quotes?
items.answer: It can draft one from the customer’s enquiry, your price lists and your rules. The final call is always yours: you check it, tweak it if needed and send it.

items.question: How do you handle company data?
items.answer: Carefully: I use business-grade services, give the AI only the data it needs and set everything up in line with the GDPR. For the most sensitive data, we weigh up the most cautious options together.

items.question: Do you work with our agency or IT provider too?
items.answer: Yes. I can support them, coordinate projects or give an independent opinion: what matters is the result for your business.

items.question: Do you work on-site?
items.answer: Yes, for businesses in Veneto and Friuli Venezia Giulia I’m happy to meet the team in person, especially during the analysis. Everything else works perfectly well remotely, wherever you are.
